mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, phone, password_hash, avatar_url, gender, age, level, total_stars, is_verified, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{avatarUrl}, #{gender, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.GenderTypeHandler}, #{age}, #{level, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UserLevelHandler}, #{totalStars}, #{isVerified}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET total_stars = #{totalStars}, level = #{level, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UserLevelHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS userId, name, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, level, total_stars AS totalStars, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_stars DESC) AS `rank` FROM users WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY total_stars DESC LIMIT 100
